_meta.batch: Dokonczenie watku Grimoire: 'Grimoire' (3, etykiety tematow), 'Grimoire 8 Gripp using Mermaids Tongue' (10), 'Grimoire 11 Town Square Dawn' (46, epilog).
_meta.important_discovery: 'Godrik' i 'Gripp' to TA SAMA POSTAC (pelne imie: Godrik Gripp). Gra przelacza sie z formalnego 'Gripp'/'Mr Gripp' na imie 'Godrik' w momentach gdy postac traci maske/zostaje przycisniety do muru (np. Grimoire 7 Parlor 3 ds157-159 - Gripp milczy, potem jako 'Godrik' mowi 'I guess this is it'; tu w Grimoire 8 pod wplywem Jezyka Syreny mowi bezladnym tekstem tez jako 'Godrik'). To NIE dwie rozne postacie - potwierdza to i uspójnia wczesniejszy wpis w GLOSSARY ('Godrik: srednia pewnosc plci' -> teraz pewne, to Gripp).
_meta.gibberish_preserved: 3 kwestie Godrika w 'Grimoire 8' to CELOWY bezsensowny ciag znakow (ds40, ds50, ds51) - efekt uzycia Jezyka Syreny/kontaktu z Syrena (ustalone wczesniej: prowadzi do szalenstwa). Zostawione BEZ ZMIAN, to nie tekst do tlumaczenia.

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: The Mermaid's Tongue is a [i]shameless shortcut[/i] - a [i]trap[/i] for the impatient and the dissolute.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Język Syreny to [i]bezwstydny skrót[/i] - [i]pułapka[/i] na niecierpliwych i zepsutych.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: But - you - you don't want to know what The Mermaid [i]said?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Ale - ty - nie chcesz wiedzieć, co Syrena [i]powiedziała?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Oh I [h]want[/h] to know.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Och, [h]chcę[/h] wiedzieć.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: It's [i]good[/i] that we don't know! It's [i]right![/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: To [i]dobrze[/i], że nie wiemy! Tak [i]powinno[/i] być!
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: What?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Co?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: But as I stand before you now, I [h]can't[/h] know - you understand? That's just - that's -
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Ale stojąc tu przed wami, [h]nie mogę[/h] wiedzieć - rozumiecie? To po prostu - to jest -
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: I don't know.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Nie wiem.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Maybe not...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Może nie...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Seems very likely...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Wygląda na bardzo prawdopodobne...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: ...is everyone okay?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: ...czy wszyscy cali?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: But - what about Gripp? Did he die or what??
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Ale - a co z Grippem? Umarł czy jak??
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: But he made his choice. I really don't think it would do us any good to worry about it.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Ale on dokonał wyboru. Naprawdę nie sądzę, żeby zamartwianie się tym cokolwiek nam dało.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: That's just the way it's meant to be.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Tak po prostu miało być.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Sally, did you, uh - did you write down that address for us?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Sally, czy ty, eee - zapisałaś nam ten adres?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Yeah, I'm almost done - just writing something on the back to help you out.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Tak, prawie skończyłam - dopisuję coś z tyłu, żeby wam pomóc.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Oh - like instructions?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Och - jakby instrukcję?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Uh... kinda, yeah.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Yy... niby tak.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Ah [i]come on,[/i] you've got nowhere to be.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Ah, [i]daj spokój[/i], nie masz gdzie się spieszyć.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: You know, I really [i]must[/i] be off.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Wiecie, naprawdę [i]muszę[/i] już iść.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: You're quite right, nowhere is [i]precisely[/i] where I need to be and I'm rather in a hurry to get there.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Masz zupełną rację, donikąd to [i]dokładnie[/i] tam, gdzie muszę być, i raczej mi się spieszy, żeby tam dotrzeć.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Alright that was pretty good, I'll let that slide.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: No dobra, to było całkiem niezłe, machnę na to ręką.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Yeah.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Tak.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Fit as a fiddle.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Zdrowa jak ryba.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: ...and, uh - Tadpole and Zephyr stayed on the submarine?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: ...i, eee - Tadpole i Zephyr zostali na łodzi podwodnej?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Oh, sure. Just had my human perspective [i]permanently and irrevocably shifted[/i], but hey, what's new.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Och, jasne. Tylko moje ludzkie postrzeganie świata zostało [i]trwale i nieodwracalnie zmienione[/i], ale hej, nic nowego.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: I guess so, huh?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Chyba tak, co?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Seems very likely...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Wygląda na bardzo prawdopodobne...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Maybe not...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Może nie...
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: I don't know.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Nie wiem.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: What about Gripp? Did he die or what??
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: A co z Grippem? Umarł czy jak??
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Are they gonna rename it?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Zmienią jej nazwę?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Of course not - you gotta keep the Mortuga name - it's like his... his fingerprint on history!
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Jasne, że nie - trzeba zachować nazwisko Mortuga - to jak jego... jego odcisk palca na historii!
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: You [i]say[/i] that, but by all accounts he actually didn't [i]like[/i] the submarine very much.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: [i]Mówisz[/i] tak, ale z tego, co wiadomo, on wcale nie [i]lubił[/i] tej łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: That's true, it wasn't his choice to [i]be there...[/i] he spent all his time trying to work out how to [i]leave...[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: To prawda, to nie był jego wybór, żeby tam [i]być...[/i] cały czas próbował wymyślić, jak [i]odejść...[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Well, yes, alright, I concede that.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Cóż, tak, dobrze, przyznaję ci rację.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Dude. That's real.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Stary. To jest prawda.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: I'd say his fingerprint is right here.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Powiedziałabym, że jego odcisk jest właśnie tutaj.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: But - what about [i]The Mermaid's Tongue?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Ale - a co z [i]Językiem Syreny?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: It's all of [i]you[/i] - It's Symmetry, it's Sinthia, Tadpole, Zephyr - everyone he was kind to, everyone he helped.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: To [i]wy[/i] wszyscy - to Symmetry, to Sinthia, Tadpole, Zephyr - każdy, dla kogo był dobry, każdy, komu pomógł.
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: Well, we still don't really know anything [i]about[/i] it, how it works, who made it-
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: Cóż, wciąż tak naprawdę nic nie wiemy [i]o[/i] nim, jak działa, kto go zrobił-
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: What [i]about[/i] it?
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: A co z [i]nim?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.en: [i]Good![/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.pl: [i]Dobrze![/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 11 Town Square Daw.speaker: Moon

do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.term: ds89 Dirk 'Dude. That's real.' -> 'Stary. To jest prawda.'
do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.problem: 'That's real' w potocznym angielskim = 'to jest głębokie/autentyczne', nie dosłownie 'prawda'. Przetlumaczone uproszczone - do rozwazenia czy 'To jest mocne' albo 'To jest szczere' lepiej oddaje ton.
